build_mlp_model: build an MLP model from a config dict with input_dim, output_dim, and hidden_dims
test_model_forward_pass: test the MLP model forward pass with a torch tensor and verify output shape
test_model_isinstance_classy: test that the built model is an instance of ClassyModel

review_test_mlp_model_class: review the TestMLPModel test class and its build and quantize test methods
